none: PAS LIN-24B926: Roman silver TOT ring
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Treasure reference no. 2016 T246: a Roman silver finger ring inscribed TOT. The ring is of Henig type VIII and has a flat, oval bezel, and triangular shoulders. The hoop is missing. The bezel bears the letters TOT - an abbreviation of the god-name Totatis or Toutatis. The letter T's have serrifed terminals, and the central letter O is the same length as the flanking letter T's.
